supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is associated with a process named gradebookproupd.exe running from Raul Diaz's user-writable AppData path, rather than the approved GradeBook Pro installation path under Program Files. The process was launched by Firefox, whose recorded command line opened a LinkedIn URL.

That process initiated proxy connections to update.gradebookpro.co, not the approved update.gradebookpro.com domain. The proxy recorded repeated attempts at approximately five-minute intervals, including denials and an authentication-required response.
Network events tie the repeated proxy connections to the AppData gradebookproupd.exe process, including the initial connection and later attempts.

The combination of an updater-like executable in a user profile, browser parentage, and a lookalike update domain is inconsistent with the supplied approved-software details and supports treating the alerted activity as likely malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show proxy CONNECT requests and some proxy outcomes, but do not provide the contents of the encrypted traffic for all connections.
The supplied records do not include a file hash, signer status, file origin, or a full process ancestry for the AppData executable.
The evidence covers the specified review window; it does not establish what happened before or after it.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the executable's contents, provenance, or whether it is definitively malware rather than an unauthorized or misconfigured installation.
The evidence does not establish that data was exfiltrated or identify any data exchanged inside encrypted tunnels.
The evidence does not establish who installed or launched the AppData executable, or whether Raul Diaz knowingly did so.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect the executable and its metadata, hash, signature, and creation/download provenance; compare it with a known-good GradeBook Pro updater.
Review endpoint process, file, browser-download, and security-product telemetry for the executable and its parent process.
Obtain proxy and DNS details for update.gradebookpro.co, including destination resolution, domain ownership/reputation, and any available request or TLS metadata.
Check for persistence, additional network activity, and related indicators on WS-RDIAZ-01.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream ran under Raul Diaz's account and contacted a Google Drive endpoint. Google Drive is not among the approved cloud-storage services in the supplied inventory; investigate separately. (T275-00044, T275-00060, T275-00061, T275-00062)

The help-desk workstation launched msra.exe targeting WS-RDIAZ-01 and used explicit credentials for raul.diaz. This is outside the alerted periodic HTTPS activity and appears inconsistent with the stated remote-administration practice; investigate separately. (T275-00050, T275-00051, T275-00053, T275-00067)

The proxy recorded a GlobalProtect/6.2.3 user agent requesting updates from updates.paloaltonetworks.com on WS-RDIAZ-01. Given the supplied context that no VPN or other remote-access service is approved, investigate separately; this record alone does not establish an active VPN connection. (T275-00357)
